payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methodologies and criteria used to evaluate the quality of the data in the CoVoST and Tatoeba datasets.

claims.text: The quality of the data is empirically evaluated through specific quality checks applied to both CoVoST and Tatoeba datasets, ensuring no poor quality translations are included.
An evaluation set is constructed from Tatoeba to complement CoVoST, filtering samples by sentence length to enhance quality and realism.
